Andhra-born candidate uses Bollywood style in Canada mayoral race

Dipika Damerla, who was born in Andhra Pradesh, is campaigning for the mayoral race in Canada using a Bollywood-style appeal. She has promised to address property taxes as part of her campaign to attract voters. Damerla holds an MBA in Finance from the Rotman School of Management.
